notes.title: Build 1.1
notes.content:
Hey!

[list]
[*] Changed the logic of the game. Now the game is more about the story and after finishing you can check out the different minigames one by one.
[*] Added exit game button to the menu.
[*] Fixed few grammar mistakes and updated dialogue.
[*] Steam Achievements added.
[*] 
[/list]

Thanks in advance for any feedback and let's make the game better! ːsteamthumbsupː
